title: A wandering black hole caught feeding on the run
summary: Astronomers detected a wandering black hole caught in the act of consuming material from a neighboring star as it travels through interstellar space, providing rare observational evidence of how rogue black holes feed during their journeys across galaxies.
problem_solved: Observes how isolated, moving black holes accrete matter from passing stars in intergalactic space.
why_valuable: Offers rare direct observation of black hole feeding behavior that was previously only theoretical, advancing our understanding of stellar-mass black hole dynamics.
